title: Asset Metadata
description: Synchronized metadata for a binary asset. Assets (originals, thumbnails, app icons) are synchronized as independent encrypted objects (FR-090a, clarified 2026-08-07) — never bundled inside an encrypted note envelope. Each asset object carries a SHA-256 contentHash for dedup and corruption detection (Constitution IV) and is independently retried on partial upload/download failure (Constitution VIII); a failed asset upload MUST NOT block synchronization of the referencing note's metadata. Thumbnails use a 256px longest edge (FR-094a) — the single canonical thumbnail size for card-grid and widget display. The asset bytes themselves are synchronized as an independent encrypted object (see encrypted-envelope.schema.json). storagePath is device-local and MUST NOT be synchronized. Scale limit (FR-090b, clarified 2026-08-07): a single asset MUST NOT exceed 50 MB raw bytes, and its longest pixel edge MUST NOT exceed 16,384 after capture/paste normalization; oversize insertions are rejected with no partial asset write. Schema version 1.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash; enables dedup and corruption detection.
